text: 32M software engineer. Cough x 6 days, started dry after 2 days of runny nose and sore throat, now yellowish sputum. Low grade fever first 2 days only, now afebrile. No breathlessness, no chest pain. Non smoker. O/E: T 37.2 C, HR 86, RR 16, BP 122/80, SpO2 98% RA. Throat mildly congested. Chest: scattered rhonchi with occasional wheeze bilaterally, no crepts, no bronchial breathing.

58 year old lady, diabetic on metformin, non smoker, presents with 10 days of dry hacking cough with soreness of chest wall on coughing. Felt feverish once, measured 99.8 F at home. No breathlessness at rest, no haemoptysis, no weight loss. On examination she is comfortable, HR 88, RR 18, SpO2 97% on room air, temp 37.6 C. Scattered rhonchi and end expiratory wheeze over both lung fields, no crepitations. CXR PA: clear lung fields, no effusion. CBC: TLC 8900, platelets 2.4 lakh. Malaria RDT negative (sent as monsoon fever protocol). RBS 168.

45M, auto driver. Fever with chills x 3d, cough with rusty sputum, R sided chest pain worse on deep breath. No comorbidities. Vitals: T 38.9, HR 108, RR 24, BP 124/78, SpO2 94% RA, conscious oriented. Chest: bronchial breathing + coarse crepts R infrascapular area. CXR: R lower lobe homogenous opacity with air bronchogram, no effusion. TLC 16,800 (N 86%). Urea 32, creat 0.9. Malaria smear negative.

67 yr old female, k/c/o HTN on amlodipine. Daughter reports 2 days fever, tiredness and poor appetite, minimal dry cough, no sputum, no chest pain. Oriented to time place person. T 38.2 C, HR 96, RR 22, BP 138/80, SpO2 93% RA. Fine crepitations left base, rest clear. Abdomen soft. Urea 34 mg/dl, creat 0.9, TLC 11,200. Portable CXR ordered, not yet done.

42 yr F, obese. RUQ pain x 2 days, constant, radiating to R shoulder, started after a heavy fried dinner. Vomited 3 times. Fever 38.4 C. HR 98, BP 130/84. Icterus absent. Tender RUQ with positive Murphy's sign, no guarding elsewhere. TLC 14,200. Bili 1.3, ALP 140, ALT 48. Lipase normal. USG abdomen: multiple calculi in GB, GB wall 5 mm with pericholecystic fluid, sonographic Murphy positive, CBD 5 mm.

72M, T2DM on insulin. c/o upper abdominal discomfort mainly right side since yesterday, 2 vomits, not eating. Low grade temp 37.9. HR 104, BP 126/74. Mild tenderness R hypochondrium, Murphy equivocal, bowel sounds present. USG done 2 years back showed gallstones, advised surgery, did not follow up. TLC 13,100. Bili 1.1, ALP normal. Lipase 1.2x ULN. ECG no acute changes, trop I negative. USG abdomen will be done in the morning when radiologist available.

68 yr old lady admitted 9 days ago with left leg skin infection, treated with IV piperacillin-tazobactam then switched to oral clindamycin. Since 3 days has watery diarrhoea 8 to 10 times a day with lower abdominal cramps. No blood in stool. Temp 38.1 C, HR 102, BP 112/70. Abdomen mildly distended, diffusely tender, no rebound. TLC 21,000. Creatinine 1.5 (0.8 on admission). Stool toxin assay sent, report pending.

54M. Loose stools 5 days, watery, ~6/day, mild crampy pain, no blood, afebrile. 1 month back took cefixime + ofloxacin from local chemist for fever x 10 days. On pantoprazole daily for 2 yrs. Vitals stable, HR 90, BP 128/82. Abdomen soft, mild LIF tenderness. TLC 11,000, creat 1.0. Stool R/E: pus cells 10-12/hpf, no RBC, no ova or cysts. Stool toxin A/B EIA: positive.

26 yr male, hostel student. 2 days frequent small volume stools with blood and mucus, 15 times since yesterday, painful straining, lower abdominal cramps, fever 39 C. Had pani puri from roadside stall 3 days ago. HR 110, BP 110/70, tongue dry. Tender left iliac fossa. Stool microscopy: plenty pus cells, RBCs 20-25/hpf, no trophozoites. TLC 13,500.

61F, diabetic. Since yesterday 12 episodes of loose stools, some streaked with blood, crampy abdominal pain, fever 38.6 C, started a day after eating at a family function. Several relatives also unwell. BP 100/64, HR 106, dry mucosa. Abdomen soft, diffuse tenderness lower abdomen. Creat 1.6 (baseline 0.9 three months ago), K 3.3. Stool routine and culture sent, pending.

24F. Since early morning 8 watery stools and 4 vomits. Attended a wedding last night, ate chicken biryani, 3 others from the same party also have loose motions. No blood, no fever. HR 102, BP 106/70, tongue dry. Abdomen soft, mild diffuse discomfort, bowel sounds increased. Na 134, K 3.4, creat 0.8, RBS 102.

35 year old man, 2 days of loose watery stools about 6 per day with nausea, body ache and mild fever 37.9 C. No blood or mucus. Several dengue cases in his colony. HR 92, BP 124/80, well hydrated. Abdomen soft, mild periumbilical discomfort. Platelets 2.1 lakh, TLC 7400. Dengue NS1 negative, malaria RDT negative. Stool R/E: pus cells 2-3/hpf, no RBC.

56M, T2DM. ERCP with CBD stenting for stones 6 weeks ago (admitted 3 days). Now 10 days fever with rigors, dull right upper abdominal pain, anorexia. T 39.2, HR 112, BP 112/70. Tender hepatomegaly 3 cm, intercostal tenderness R lower chest. TLC 19,800. Bili 1.8, ALP 380 (ULN 120), ALT 76. Malaria smear negative. USG: 7 x 6 cm hypoechoic lesion R lobe segment VII with internal echoes and debris, CBD stent in situ, CBD not dilated.

38 yr old male, daily country liquor drinker, presenting with 2 weeks of fever and right upper abdominal pain that worsens on deep breathing and coughing, pain also felt at right shoulder tip. No jaundice, no diarrhoea currently. T 38.7 C, HR 104. Liver palpable 4 cm, very tender, intercostal tenderness present. Right base dull with reduced air entry. TLC 17,400, ALP 290, ALT 64, albumin 2.9. USG abdomen: single 8 cm hypoechoic lesion in right lobe of liver, small right sided effusion. Serology for amoebic antibody sent.

52M farmer, diabetic poorly controlled. Thorn prick L leg 3 days back. Since last night severe pain whole L leg, swelling spreading from ankle to knee over 12 hrs. Now drowsy. O/E: toxic, T 38.8, HR 128, BP 88/56. L leg tense, red, warm, dusky purple patches, haemorrhagic blisters, crepitus felt over calf, pain far more than what the skin looks like. TLC 24,000, Na 128, creat 2.1, RBS 380, lactate 4.6. X-ray leg: gas in soft tissue planes.

60 yr male, diabetic, drinks daily. Boil near anus 4 days ago, now severe perineal and scrotal pain with swelling since 1 day. Foul smelling discharge. O/E: T 38.4 C, HR 118, BP 100/64. Scrotum and perineum swollen and red with a blackish patch on scrotal skin, foul pus draining. Tenderness extends beyond redness up to lower abdominal wall. No crepitus felt. TLC 19,000, RBS 310, creat 1.4, Na 131.

28F. Burning micturition and frequency x 3 days, since yesterday high fever with chills, L flank pain, 2 vomits. LMP 2 wks ago, UPT negative. T 39.4, HR 114, BP 118/74. L renal angle tenderness. Urine R/E: plenty pus cells, nitrite positive. TLC 15,600, creat 0.8. USG KUB: no hydronephrosis, no calculus.

24 yr G2P1 at 22 weeks, fever 2 days and right flank pain radiating to front, nausea. Denies burning micturition. T 38.6 C, HR 104, BP 110/70. Right CVA tenderness, uterus corresponds to dates, FHS present. TLC 14,800. Urine routine and culture sent, report awaited.

66M, DM. Fever 4d with burning micturition, now drowsy since morning. BP 78/44 after 2 L NS, noradrenaline started, currently 0.2 mcg/kg/min. HR 124, RR 28, SpO2 95% RA, T 39.1. Urine output 10 ml/hr. Lactate 5.8. TLC 22,400, plt 88,000, creat 2.8. Urine: plenty pus cells, nitrite +. USG KUB: L moderate hydronephrosis with 8 mm upper ureteric calculus.

45 year old woman with SLE on prednisolone 20 mg daily and mycophenolate. Two days of fever and vomiting, today confused. BP 80/50 even after 30 ml/kg crystalloid, noradrenaline started. HR 132, RR 26, T 39.4 C, cold peripheries. No focal chest, abdominal or skin source on exam, no neck stiffness. Lactate 4.2, TLC 18,000, creat 1.9. CXR clear. Urine 4-6 pus cells. Malaria RDT and dengue NS1 negative. Blood and urine cultures sent.

22M, college student, eats outside daily. Fever 5 days which settled, followed by loss of appetite, nausea, yellow eyes and dark urine x 3 days. Mild right upper abdominal discomfort. Afebrile now. Icterus ++, liver 2 cm tender, no flap, oriented. Bili 6.8, ALT 2340, AST 1780, ALP 210, INR 1.2. Malaria smear negative, dengue NS1 negative, leptospira IgM negative.

34 yr old female, 2 weeks of malaise, joint pains in hands and knees, then yellowish urine and eyes since 5 days. Nausea. No fever. Denies alcohol, herbal medicines, ATT or recent new drugs. Icteric, no asterixis, liver just palpable, mildly tender. Bili 4.2, ALT 1460, AST 980, ALP 160, INR 1.1. USG: normal CBD, no calculi. Serology sent, pending.

64M, HTN, known AF, stopped warfarin 2 months ago on his own. Sudden severe pain R leg since 4 hrs, leg feels cold and numb, cannot move toes properly. O/E: R leg pale and cold below knee with mottling, femoral pulse palpable, popliteal/DP/PT absent. Reduced touch sensation over foot, weak dorsiflexion. L leg pulses normal. HR 110 irregular. ECG: irregularly irregular rhythm, no ST changes.

71 year old lady, diabetic, ex smoker, walks with calf pain after 200 m for a year. Now 2 days of worsening left foot pain even at rest, keeping her awake, not relieved by paracetamol or tramadol. Foot is cold and toes bluish, capillary refill sluggish, minimal swelling. No pulses palpable below left femoral. Right foot pulses feeble but present. No fever, no wound. Sensation over toes reduced. Arterial Doppler requested, pending.

29F. Easy fatigue x 3 months, breathless on climbing one floor, palpitations. Heavy periods with clots for 1 yr. O/E: marked pallor, koilonychia, HR 112, BP 104/66, soft systolic flow murmur, no pedal edema, lungs clear. Hb 5.4, MCV 62, plt 4.2 lakh, TLC 6800. ECG sinus tachycardia.

69 yr male, takes aspirin daily on his own for 'heart protection'. 6 weeks progressive breathlessness on walking, chest tightness on walking uphill, ankle swelling. Has not noticed black stools. O/E: pale, HR 108, BP 130/70, JVP not raised, bilateral pitting ankle edema, lungs clear. Hb 5.9, MCV 68. ECG: sinus tachycardia, 1 mm ST depression V4 to V6. Trop I 12 ng/L (normal). NT-proBNP 780. Stool occult blood pending.

62F, HTN. Sudden onset palpitations since 6 hrs with mild breathlessness, no chest pain, no syncope. HR 146 irregularly irregular, pulse deficit present, BP 128/84, SpO2 97%, lungs clear. ECG: narrow complex tachycardia, irregularly irregular, no P waves, no ST elevation. Trop I normal. TSH 2.1. K 4.2.

38 yr old woman with 5 kg weight loss over 3 months, heat intolerance, tremors, now palpitations for 2 days. No fever. HR 156 irregular, BP 136/70, alert and oriented, T 37.2 C. Fine tremor, warm moist skin, diffuse neck swelling moving with swallowing. ECG: irregular narrow complex tachycardia with no discernible P waves. TSH less than 0.01, free T4 3.8 ng/dl.

30M farmer, brought 2 hrs after drinking about 50 ml of an insecticide kept in the shed after a family quarrel. Container not brought, relatives do not know the name. Vomiting, excess salivation, sweating. O/E: GCS 13, pupils pinpoint, fasciculations over calves, HR 52, BP 100/60, RR 26, SpO2 90% RA, bilateral crepitations with copious secretions. Serum cholinesterase sent.

45 yr female, swallowed Furadan granules mixed in water 1 hour ago, bag brought by husband (carbofuran 3% CG). Excess salivation and tears, abdominal cramps, loose stools x 3, vomiting. Conscious, GCS 15. Pupils 1.5 mm, HR 48, BP 110/70, RR 22, SpO2 94% RA, scattered wheeze.

48M, HTN on hydrochlorothiazide. Had beer at a party last night, woke at 3 am with severe pain R big toe, cannot bear even the bedsheet touching it. O/E: 1st MTP joint R red, hot, swollen, shiny skin, exquisitely tender. T 37.8. No wound, no lymphangitis. Uric acid 8.9, TLC 11,200.

74 year old lady, diabetic, painful swollen right knee for 2 days, unable to walk. Temp 38.2 C. Knee warm with moderate effusion, painful restricted movement. TLC 13,200, CRP 96. Knee X-ray: linear calcification in the menisci, no fracture. Joint aspirate: turbid, WBC 22,000 (80% N), Gram stain no organisms, polarised microscopy shows rhomboid weakly positively birefringent inclusions. Culture pending.

19F, T1DM on basal bolus insulin. Missed insulin for 2 days during exams, passing lots of urine, vomiting since yesterday, abdominal pain, breathing fast. Drowsy but responds to voice. RR 32 deep, HR 124, BP 98/60, very dry. RBS 486. Urine ketones 3+. ABG: pH 7.08, HCO3 6, AG 28. Na 131, K 5.4.

52 yr male, T2DM on empagliflozin and metformin. Poor oral intake for 3 days after dental extraction, then nausea, vomiting, vague abdominal pain and breathlessness. Alert. RR 28, HR 102, BP 124/78, afebrile. RBS 198. ABG: pH 7.14, HCO3 8, anion gap 26. Serum beta hydroxybutyrate 5.8 mmol/L. Lactate 1.6. Lipase normal. Creat 1.1.

17M. Puffy face every morning x 5 days, cola coloured urine, passing less urine. Had skin sores on legs 3 weeks ago which have healed. BP 168/100. Periorbital puffiness, mild pedal edema, lungs clear. Urine: protein 2+, RBC plenty, RBC casts seen. Creat 1.9. C3 low. ASO titre raised.

34 year old female with 1 week of reduced urine output and red coloured urine, now mildly breathless. No rash, no joint pains, no cough or blood in sputum. BP 170/104, bilateral pedal edema, fine basal crackles both sides. Urine: protein 3+, RBC 40-50/hpf mostly dysmorphic, RBC casts present. Creatinine 4.2 (1.8 one week ago), K 5.9. USG: normal sized kidneys, no hydronephrosis. NT-proBNP 2400. ANA, ANCA and anti-GBM sent.

64F, Ca breast with bone mets on letrozole. 1 wk increasing confusion, constipation, passing lot of urine, vomiting, now drowsy. Dry mucosa, BP 100/60, HR 98. Corrected calcium 14.2 mg/dl, albumin 3.2, creat 1.8. ECG short QT. CT head: no bleed, infarct or mass.

58 yr male, smoker 40 pack years, weight loss of 7 kg in 2 months and cough. For 5 days increasing lethargy, excessive thirst, abdominal pain and constipation. Slow to respond but oriented. Afebrile. CXR: right hilar mass. Serum calcium 13.1 mg/dl, albumin 3.8, creat 1.4. PTH sent.

72F, HTN on hydrochlorothiazide, escitalopram started 3 wks ago for low mood. 3 days confusion and unsteady walking, fell at home yesterday without head injury noted, today one generalised tonic clonic fit. Now GCS 13, no focal deficit, clinically euvolaemic. Na 112, K 3.6, serum osm 238, urine osm 420, urine Na 48, RBS 118. CT head: no bleed, infarct or mass.

55 yr old man, drinks 6 to 8 bottles of beer a day and eats very little. 4 days of nausea, headache and vomiting, since today confused and disoriented. Afebrile, no neck stiffness, no focal signs. Na 116, K 3.1, RBS 104. CT head requested, not yet done.

26F, BMI 34. Headache x 3 months, worse in the morning and on lying down, episodes of vision going dark for a few seconds on standing, whooshing sound in ears. Fundus: bilateral papilloedema. Neuro exam otherwise normal. MRI brain with MRV: no mass, no venous sinus thrombosis, partially empty sella. LP: opening pressure 34 cm H2O, CSF cells, protein, glucose normal.

31 year old woman, gained 12 kg over the past year, on doxycycline for acne for 2 months. Headache for 6 weeks with blurred vision and nausea. Afebrile. Fundoscopy: bilateral optic disc swelling. No focal deficit. Plain CT head: normal, no bleed, infarct or mass. MR venogram booked, LP planned after that.

45M. Evening fever with drenching night sweats x 2 months, lost 8 kg, itching all over. Painless swellings in neck and axilla slowly enlarging. O/E: multiple rubbery, non tender, discrete nodes cervical and axillary 2-3 cm, spleen 3 cm. Hb 10.2, TLC 9800, LDH 780. Mantoux negative. Sputum CBNAAT negative. Malaria smear negative. CXR: widened mediastinum. FNAC pending.

68 yr male with 3 months of loss of appetite, early satiety, 10 kg weight loss, night sweats and low grade fevers. No cough. Liver palpable 5 cm, hard and nodular. Hb 8.9, ALP 410, ALT 60, bili 1.2. USG abdomen: multiple hypoechoic target lesions throughout the liver. Malaria RDT negative.

34F, AChR antibody positive, on pyridostigmine 60 mg QID and prednisolone 10 mg. Cold and sore throat 3 days. Since yesterday difficulty swallowing, liquids coming through nose, nasal voice, breathless. O/E: bilateral ptosis, weak neck flexion, RR 28 shallow, SpO2 95% RA. Single breath count 8. FVC 0.9 L (predicted 3.2). ABG pCO2 52. Reflexes normal, no sensory loss, pupils normal, no excess secretions.

58 yr old man, drooping eyelids and double vision in the evenings for 6 months, on pyridostigmine. Local doctor gave azithromycin 4 days ago for sore throat. Now breathless especially on lying flat, weak voice, drooling, cannot hold head up. RR 30 with paradoxical abdominal movement, SpO2 91% RA, HR 106. ABG: pH 7.30, pCO2 58. Reflexes preserved, sensation intact, pupils normal size. CXR clear.

24M brought by friends from a party, found unresponsive in bathroom with a syringe nearby. GCS 6, RR 6/min shallow, SpO2 82% RA, pupils pinpoint, HR 58, BP 100/60, T 35.8. Needle track marks both forearms. RBS 112. No head injury seen.

78 yr female, CKD stage 4, started on tramadol 50 mg TDS by local doctor for knee pain 4 days ago. Progressively drowsy since 2 days. RR 8, SpO2 88% RA, pupils small, HR 64, BP 136/80, afebrile. No focal deficit, no neck stiffness. RBS 146, Na 138, creat 3.4 (baseline 3.1). CT head: no bleed, infarct or mass.

52M, taking diclofenac for low back pain x 3 wks. 2 episodes black tarry stools since yesterday, 1 coffee ground vomitus today, giddy on standing. No alcohol, no known liver disease. HR 112, BP 102/68 lying, 86/60 standing. Pallor ++. Epigastric tenderness. No jaundice, no ascites, no spider naevi. Hb 7.8 (13 last year), urea 88, creat 1.0, INR 1.0.

36 yr male, smoker, burning upper abdominal pain for 3 months, wakes him at night, better after eating. Since yesterday passing black sticky stools, no blood vomiting. No alcohol, no NSAID use. HR 96, BP 118/76, mild pallor, epigastric tenderness. No stigmata of chronic liver disease. Hb 10.4, urea 56. Endoscopy scheduled.

22M, tall thin, smoker. Sudden sharp R sided chest pain at rest 3 hrs ago, worse on breathing in, with breathlessness. RR 26, HR 110, SpO2 92% RA, BP 120/80. Trachea central. R side: reduced breath sounds, hyperresonant note. CXR: visible pleural line with 3 cm rim devoid of lung markings on R.

64 yr old man, known COPD on tiotropium and formoterol inhalers. Sudden worsening of breathlessness today with left sided chest pain. No fever, no change in sputum colour or volume. RR 32, SpO2 84% RA, HR 124, BP 110/70. Barrel chest, left hemithorax hyperresonant with absent breath sounds, scattered wheeze on right. ECG: sinus tachycardia, no ST elevation. D-dimer 0.3 (normal). Portable CXR called.

44F, HTN. Sudden severe headache while straining at toilet, 'worst headache of my life', vomited twice, brief blackout. GCS 14, neck stiff, photophobia, no focal deficit. BP 190/104, HR 64. CT head (2 hrs from onset): hyperdensity in basal cisterns and both sylvian fissures, no parenchymal bleed.

38 yr male, gym instructor. 3 days ago while lifting heavy weights, sudden severe occipital headache reaching peak within a minute. Took painkillers, headache persists with some neck pain. Afebrile, GCS 15, mild neck stiffness, no focal signs, fundus normal. CT head today: no bleed, infarct or mass. LP: xanthochromia present, RBC 2400 in tube 1 and 2200 in tube 4.

19M from Kalahandi, Odisha. Known HbSS (HbS 86% on electrophoresis), on hydroxyurea. Got drenched in rain yesterday, since then severe pain in lower back and both thighs, crying in pain, not relieved by paracetamol. T 37.6, HR 108, RR 18, SpO2 97% RA, chest clear. Mild icterus. Hb 7.4 (baseline 8), retic 9%. Malaria smear negative. CXR clear.

24 year old woman from south Gujarat, known HbSS. Two days of severe pain in both knees, ankles and lower back. No fever. Joints tender but not red or swollen. SpO2 98% on air, chest clear, no chest pain. Mild jaundice. Hb 6.8, indirect bilirubin 3.2, LDH 640.

58M, smoker 35 pack years. 3 wks progressive swelling of face, neck and both arms, worse on bending and lying down, head fullness, breathlessness, lost 5 kg. Cough x 2 months. O/E: facial plethora, distended non pulsatile neck veins, dilated veins over upper chest wall. No stridor. SpO2 95%. CXR: right superior mediastinal widening with right upper zone mass.

46 yr female on haemodialysis via right internal jugular tunnelled catheter for 1 year. Two weeks of progressive swelling of face and right arm, head fullness when bending. Afebrile, catheter exit site clean, no tenderness. Dilated superficial veins over upper chest. Blood cultures last week sterile. Echo: no vegetation, normal LV function.

67M, HTN, DM. This morning 40 min episode of R hand and face weakness with slurred speech, completely recovered. Now NIHSS 0, speech normal. BP 168/96. ECG sinus rhythm. RBS 164. CT head: no bleed, infarct or mass.

58 yr old woman, hypertensive. Yesterday sudden loss of vision in left eye like a curtain coming down, lasted about 5 minutes and recovered fully. No headache, no jaw pain. Examination today normal, visual acuity 6/6 both eyes, fundus normal. ECG sinus rhythm. CT head: no bleed, infarct or mass. Carotid Doppler pending.

42M. 2 months nasal crusting with bloody discharge and pain over cheeks, 2 wks cough with blood streaked sputum, joint pains, red urine. Lost 4 kg. T 37.9, BP 150/90. Nasal septum crusted. Urine: RBC plenty, protein 2+, RBC casts. Creat 2.6. CXR/HRCT: multiple bilateral nodules, some cavitating. Sputum AFB smear and CBNAAT negative.

55 year old woman with 6 weeks of fever, weight loss, muscle aches and tingling in feet, now right foot drop. Crops of raised purple spots on both legs that do not blanch. Pain in abdomen after meals. BP 170/100. Urine: protein 1+, RBC 10-15/hpf. Creatinine 1.4, ESR 92. Malaria and dengue tests negative, two blood cultures sterile, echo shows no vegetation.

34M, daily alcohol intake x 8 yrs. Fever with chills x 10 days, dull aching pain R hypochondrium radiating to R shoulder, worse on deep breath. O/E: febrile 102F, HR 108, tender hepatomegaly 3 cm, intercostal tenderness R lower ribs, no jaundice. TLC 18,400 (N 82%). ALP 310 (ULN 129), bili 1.2, ALT 64. USG abdomen: single 7 x 6 cm hypoechoic lesion with low-level internal echoes, R lobe posterosuperior segment, no biliary dilatation, GB normal.

45 yr old male farmer from rural Bihar. Low grade fever for 3 weeks with loss of appetite and about 5 kg weight loss. Heaviness in right upper abdomen. Had loose stools with mucus and blood about 6 weeks back, treated by local practitioner, resolved. Not diabetic. On exam: pale, liver palpable 4 cm below costal margin, tender, point tenderness in right 9th intercostal space. Malaria RDT negative. Hb 10.1, TLC 13,200. Ultrasound: solitary 9 cm hypoechoic area in right lobe, abutting the diaphragm, no gallstones, CBD normal.

72M, old L MCA infarct, bedbound at home, Foley catheter in situ for 3 weeks (changed once). Brought with fever 102F with rigors since last night, urine in bag cloudy and foul smelling, reduced intake. HR 112, BP 118/70, RR 20, SpO2 96% RA. Chest clear. No bedsores. Suprapubic tenderness present. TLC 16,200. Urine R/M: 50 to 60 pus cells/hpf, nitrite positive. Urine and blood cultures sent.

65F, T2DM, admitted 6 days ago with fracture neck of femur, operated day 2. Foley in place since admission as she is not mobilising. Today temp 101.2F, new confusion since evening, HR 106, BP 124/76, SpO2 97% RA. Wound clean and dry. Chest clear, CXR no new shadow. Calves soft. Mild L renal angle tenderness. Urine sample and cultures sent, report awaited.

28 yr old woman, headache for 3 weeks, low grade fever mostly in the evenings, vomiting for 1 week, now drowsy since yesterday and complaining of double vision. Husband is on ATT for 2 months. Lost about 4 kg. O/E: GCS 13 (E3V4M6), neck stiffness present, Kernig positive, right lateral rectus palsy, no papilloedema. CT head contrast: mild hydrocephalus with basal meningeal enhancement. CSF: cells 220/cmm, 85% lymphocytes, protein 180 mg/dl, glucose 32 mg/dl (blood 110), ADA 14 U/L, Gram stain negative.

52M, HIV positive on ART for 1 yr (CD4 180 two months ago). Wife reports 10 days of odd behaviour, forgetting things, low grade fever. One GTCS this morning. O/E: T 100.2F, disoriented, mild neck rigidity, no focal deficit. Na 124. CT head plain: no bleed, infarct or mass, ventricles normal size. CSF: 150 cells (lymphocytes 80%), protein 240, glucose 28 (blood 104), ADA 12, India ink and CrAg negative, Gram stain negative. Xpert on CSF pending.

24M, IT employee, Hyderabad, Sept. Fever x 3 days, high grade, with severe body ache, headache and pain behind the eyes. No cough, no burning micturition. Flushed face. BP 118/76, HR 96. Tourniquet test negative. Hb 15.2, Hct 44, TLC 3,200, platelets 88,000. NS1 antigen positive. Malaria RDT negative. LFT: AST 96, ALT 70.

32F, fever for 5 days, fever settled yesterday but since morning has pain abdomen, vomited 5 times, gum bleeding while brushing. O/E: cold extremities, CRT 3 sec, HR 118, BP 86/72, abdomen tender RUQ, mild free fluid. Hct 48 (was 38 on day 2), platelets 22,000, TLC 2,800. USG: GB wall oedematous thickened, mild ascites, small right pleural effusion. Serology sent, report awaited. Malaria smear negative.

38M, fever and headache for 4 days, since yesterday talking irrelevantly and not recognising family, 2 episodes of GTCS today. O/E: T 102F, GCS 11 (E3V3M5), neck stiffness equivocal, no focal deficit, pupils normal. BP 130/80. CT head: normal. CSF: 60 cells, 90% lymphocytes, protein 70, glucose 68 (blood 120), Gram stain no organisms. MRI brain booked for tomorrow. Malaria smear negative.

19 yr old girl from village near Gorakhpur, August. High fever 3 days, then became unresponsive with abnormal movements of limbs. O/E: GCS 8, generalised rigidity, coarse tremors of hands, one focal seizure in ED. No rash, no eschar. BP 110/70. Malaria RDT negative, platelets 2.1 lakh, blood glucose 118, Na 136. CSF: 90 cells, lymphocytes predominant, protein 64, glucose 70 (blood 118).

67M, admitted 6 days ago, laparotomy for perforated duodenal ulcer, got cefuroxime peri-op x 3 days. Since yesterday fever 101.8F, cough with yellow-green sputum, SpO2 91% RA, RR 26. Crepts R base. Abdomen wound healthy, drains minimal. TLC 17,500. CXR: new R lower zone consolidation. Not on ventilator. Sputum C/S sent.

58F, diabetic, admitted in ICU 4 days back with ketoacidosis, now resolved and on SC insulin. Had ESBL E. coli in urine last year. Since this afternoon febrile 100.8F, O2 requirement gone up from room air to 4 L/min by nasal prongs to keep SpO2 93%, RR 28. Occasional cough, scanty sputum. Portable CXR: new left lower lobe opacity. Blood and sputum cultures sent.

46M, heavy drinker. Was found unconscious after a binge about 3 weeks ago. Since 2 weeks cough with large amount of foul smelling sputum, fever, weight loss. Poor oral hygiene with dental caries. O/E T 101F, bronchial breath sounds R infrascapular region. TLC 15,800. CXR: thick walled cavity with air-fluid level in right upper lobe posterior segment. Sputum AFB negative x 2.

60M, T2DM, old brainstem stroke with swallowing difficulty, coughs while eating. 10 days of fever, cough, right sided chest pain on breathing, streaks of blood in sputum since 2 days. HR 104, SpO2 94% RA. CT chest: 5 cm cavity with air fluid level in superior segment of right lower lobe, no mediastinal nodes. Sputum CBNAAT sent, result pending.
